symptom: On Mendix 9.0–9.19 every pluggable widget's schema lost the Type of its return types and kept an AssignableTo the version does not have (49 return types across the embedded templates); a CustomWidgets$WidgetReturnType reaching the floor there was refused: `this Mendix 9.18.0 project cannot store CustomWidgets$WidgetReturnType.Type (Mendix 9.20.0+)`. Forms$GroupBox had caption at 8.10 and no row for headerMode
cause: The vendored generator (modelsdk/gen/*/version.go) gave a property the row of the NEXT property in the SDK's versionInfo and left that one out, as it did Microflows$AggregateAction.aggregateFunction: mendixmodelsdk 4.117.0 has WidgetReturnType `type: {}`, `assignableTo: {introduced 9.20.0}` and pages.GroupBox `caption: {}`, `headerMode: {introduced 8.10.0}`. canon.PropertyDeclared reads the same table, and widgetTypeForVersion uses it to drop undeclared keys from the embedded 11.6 widget schema, so the wrong row dropped the right key
insight: **Compare the whole table with the SDK, then read each hit's neighbour**: a text extractor over the SDK's gen/*.js StructureVersionInfo (map Pages$ to Forms$ for storage names; never execute the SDK) found 50 differences; most are SDK data newer than the vendored generator (11.11–11.16 rows it lacks), and five are this misattribution, always 'property gets its neighbour's version, neighbour missing': AggregateAction.aggregateFunction, WidgetReturnType.type, GroupBox.caption, and on Deleted LayoutGridRow.columns (← class, 8.0 — the row propertyfloor.go cites as why generated deletions are not trusted) and DynamicImageViewer.showAsThumbnail (← onClickBehavior, 7.18), plus a never-looked-up SDK-named duplicate row Microflows$AggregateListAction. The Deleted ones and the duplicate change nothing the floor does and were left. Workflows$CallMicroflowTask.boundaryEvents was NOT a mismatch (10.14.0 on both sides): the earlier list's fourth row was a false positive. **Check which BSON key a row is looked up by before predicting its effect**: the floor keys by the lower-cased BSON key, and a group box's caption is stored as CaptionTemplate, so the wrong caption row never applied to anything; headerMode's 8.10 is below every version mxcli writes — the GroupBox fix corrects the data and changes no write. **Studio Pro-authored bytes settle a row faster than a platform run when no mxbuild of that version is cached**: Marketplace samples carry whole apps — Employee Onboarding (9.1.1) stores {EntityProperty,IsList,Type} on 208 of 208 return types, Example project workflow extension 2.0.0 (9.4.0) on 326 of 326, Multilevel Dynamic Workflow (9.24.3) adds AssignableTo on 57 of 57. For boundaryEvents the oracle was a floor-off build on 10.12.19: mxcli then writes `BoundaryEvents: [2]` on every call, mx check passes, mx convert 10.12.19 strips it — the existing floor's drop-empty is what keeps the write clean, and a stated boundary event is refused. Tests: TestTemplateWidgetReturnTypeKeysAcrossMendix9_20 (fails on the old row with 49 wrong key sets at 9.18), TestNormalize_WidgetReturnTypeAcrossMendix9_20, TestPropertyDeclared_RowsTheGeneratorMisattributed, TestNormalize_CallMicroflowBoundaryEventsBelowMendix10_14 (control: removing the row fails it). Seen in passing, not fixed: on 9.24.30 a page with a slider or a data grid 2, written by mxcli, stops mx check (and its update-widgets step) with `NullReferenceException at WidgetValue.IsDefault() (WidgetValue.cs:879)`, with or without these fixes; 10.24.24 and 11.13.0 check the same pages at 0 errors.
